why: The apply/call forms the reading leaves refused (design/push-apply.md), each by unsupported-member with applyCall's reason, in the lint and in the translator alike (escapes push_apply, push_apply_list, push_apply_this, library_members_push_apply), so lane A checks nothing here. Lane B judges each against the direct call: listAny (a list typed any) is a WITNESS, since apply lists a string's length and indexes as an object and throws on a primitive where a spread iterates it; Bag.addAll is a WITNESS, since the apply form reads the receiver field this.items twice and the direct call once, and the bounded run traces each read of a receiver field (the reason a receiver reached through `this` or a module binding is not rewritten); onRecord (push borrowed onto an array-like record, written through Array.prototype on the candidate) and bound (push bound to a value, then called) are bounded passes.
